# Citations

Sources for [Agent Harness Capabilities and an Isolated Trial Setup](analysis.md).
Numbered sequentially. Tier per the cited-research scale: T1 peer-reviewed /
government / institutional record (CVE records from MITRE's CVE Services API
count here), T2 vendor documentation, vendor repositories and established
reference sites, T3 industry blogs, trade press, security-vendor research and
preprints, T4 forums, GitHub issues/discussions, personal blogs and community
projects. Vendor documentation is the vendor describing its own product. It is
authoritative for configuration and defaults, and self-interested for claims
about safety or quality.

All URLs were fetched in-session on 2026-11-05 through the sandbox fetch
service. Sources were discovered through a single search engine (Yahoo). See
[analysis.md § Limitations](analysis.md#limitations).

## Local context (not web citations)

- [`openshell-sandbox` README](https://github.com/jewzaam/openshell-sandbox) and
  `bin/harness-wrapper.sh` (local copy at `/sandbox/source/openshell-sandbox/`):
  `--harness claude|codex`; `valid_harness()` accepts only those two; profiles
  `work` / `personal` / `home`; `personal` and `home` authenticate Anthropic
  directly, `work` may use `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`.
